signals.text: Premier Wraparound Care For more than 20 years, Premier Education has been delivering high-quality provision to primary schools nationwide, offering physical education, holiday camps, and a wide range of extra-curricular activities across both sporting and non-sporting subjects.

signals.text: We believe that nurturing children who understand and actively embrace democracy, the rule of law, individual liberty, mutual respect, and tolerance is crucial for their development into responsible and well-rounded citizens, both within the school community and beyond.
Portfields Vision Our Vision Our values & ethos are built around our school logo: the Tickford Bridge in Newport Pagnell, which is the oldest iron bridge in the world.

Portfields Vision
Our Vision
Our values & ethos are built around our school logo: the Tickford Bridge in Newport Pagnell, which is the oldest iron bridge in the world. This symbol of strength, connection and a pathway to enable growth is the core of our vision. ​The Portfields vision is to:
To deepen our positive relationships and partnerships with our Portfields School family and the local, national and global community.
To lead and innovate initiatives for exceptional educational and personal experiences where all members of the Portfields family take ownership of their learning.
Together, no challenge or situation is too big. We overcome obstacles by taking risks, supporting each other and building personal strength and resilience to face an ever-changing world.
Our curriculum and enrichment opportunities inspire learners and nurture talents to create aspirational goals and unique lasting memories.
Strengthen
Portfields Vision

British Values
At Portfields Primary School, fostering a strong sense of British values lies at the heart of our school. We believe that nurturing children who understand and actively embrace democracy, the rule of law, individual liberty, mutual respect, and tolerance is crucial for their development into responsible and well-rounded citizens, both within the school community and beyond. This commitment is woven into the fabric of our daily life, shaping every aspect of our curriculum, interactions, and school culture.
British Values Statement pdf
British Values

Head's Welcome
I am very proud to be able to share with you the wonderful opportunities and achievements at Portfields Primary School!
Portfields Primary School is a vibrant, inclusive school where children are enthusiastic and motivated to achieve endless possibilities. The children are at the heart of every decision we make to ensure that they are happy, confident and that the opportunities that are provided for them are relevant to their needs both now and in the future.
At Portfields, we believe that children should be curious about their learning. Through our engaging curriculum, we ensure that children can foster a passion for learning that will help to develop high aspirations and a lifetime of memories. We believe in ensuring that children receive a well-rounded curriculum; where individual talents can be spotted and nurtured to ensure that all children experience success and reach their full potential.

Premier Wraparound Care
For more than 20 years, Premier Education has been delivering high-quality provision to primary schools nationwide, offering physical education, holiday camps, and a wide range of extra-curricular activities across both sporting and non-sporting subjects.
In 2016, we expanded our services to include wraparound care, bringing together our expertise in active, engaging provision with a convenient and seamless experience for parents. Our commitment to creating healthy, active, and enriching environments has made us the trusted choice for a growing number of schools.
From May 2023, Premier Education is proud to be partnering with Portfields Primary School to deliver exceptional wraparound care.
Our Wraparound Provision
Running every day the school is open, 3pm until 6:00 pm, our wraparound care offers a safe, fun, and nurturing environment that both children and parents can trust.
What Premier Education Wraparound Offers:
✅ Engaging Activities – From gymnastics to gardening, children can enjoy a wide variety of fun, active, and stimulating experiences.
✅ Nutritious Meals & Snacks – A balanced menu designed to meet school food standards.
✅ Easy Online Booking – A straightforward system with instant confirmation, helping parents manage sessions effortlessly.
✅ Responsive Support – Our friendly team is available by phone or email, ensuring quick and helpful responses to any queries.
✅ Flexible Scheduling – Book up to 1:00 PM on the same day, perfect for last-minute changes.
✅ Stress-Free Refunds – With our ‘Flexi Bookings’ option, parents can claim a no-questions-asked refund for any missed session.
We’re thrilled to be supporting families at Kents Hill Park Primary School and look forward to welcoming your child to Premier Education Wraparound Care!
Stella Momoh Edwards
Life at Our Wraparound Care
Our wraparound care offers a true home-from-home environment, where children can relax, recharge, and feel at ease after a busy school day. Whether they’d like some quiet time or prefer to dive into exciting activities, there’s always something to enjoy in our warm and nurturing environment.
Every session is packed with fun and creativity. Children can lose themselves in imaginative play, build amazing structures with Lego, K’NEX, and building blocks, explore their artistic side at our creative stations, while our end-of-week movie night—complete with popcorn—offers the perfect opportunity to unwind with friends.
Alongside free play, we provide an enriching programme of adult-led activities designed to spark curiosity and broaden horizons. From edible crafts and construction challenges to team games and global themes, our sessions inspire children to learn about the wider world in engaging, stimulating ways. They might create traditional art from different cultures, engineer international landmarks, or take part in group challenges inspired by customs from around the globe.
More than just a wraparound club, we’re a community. Whether your child joins us every day or just now and then, they’ll always feel at home here.
Timings & Prices for Wraparound Care
We provide flexible wraparound care designed to fit your family’s routine, offering a safe, engaging, and fun space for your child before and after school. Sessions run every day the school is open, with different pick-up times to suit your schedule.
Session Options & Pricing:
All sessions include a wide variety of activities, from creative play to team games, plus a healthy snack in line with school food standards. Children staying until 6:00 pm will also enjoy a light tea, served between 5:00 pm and 5:15 pm.
How to Book Our Wraparound Care
Booking your child’s place at Premier Education Wraparound Care is quick and easy. Simply visit Premier Education – Portfields to get started.
New to Our Services?
If you’re booking with us for the first time, you will need to create an account. As part of the registration process, we will collect some important details—such as medical and dietary information—so we can provide the best care and support for your child.
Booking Your Sessions
Once your account is created, simply log in, choose your sessions, and confirm your booking in just a few clicks. You’ll receive an instant email confirmation, making it easy to keep track of your child’s schedule.
Important Information
To maintain safe staff-to-child ratios, all sessions run on a first-come, first-served basis, with bookings accepted until 1:00 pm on the same day. We encourage booking early to guarantee your child’s place.
If you have any questions or need help with bookings, our friendly support team is here to assist. We look forward to welcoming your child to our wraparound care!

At Premier Education, we understand that school holidays can be a juggling act for busy parents—that’s why we provide exciting, high-quality childcare when schools are closed. Our holiday camps, running at venues across Milton Keynes, offer a safe and vibrant environment where children can stay active, make friends, and take part in a wide variety of activities.
As the UK’s leading provider of sport and physical activity, we deliver expert coaching and fun, engaging games at every camp. But the experience doesn’t stop at sport—children also enjoy arts & crafts, outdoor adventures, team challenges, and themed enrichment activities that spark creativity and curiosity.
With flexible booking options and a programme designed to suit different ages and interests, our holiday camps give parents peace of mind while offering children days filled with fun, learning, and new experiences.

Our House System
We are delighted to announce the reintroduction of our House System in September 2024.
From the start of school, all pupils are assigned to one of our three school houses: Green, Orange, and Purple. Siblings are always in the same house, as we believe this fosters a sense of community (and prevents any family rivalry at home!)
Each September, we hold a competition where children are given the opportunity to name their house for the academic year. Our theme for 2024 is "Sporting Heroes".
Each child's individual achievements, tracked through our Class Charts software, contribute to their house's overall success. Competitive events – academic and sporting – are held throughout the school year. Points are assigned, and the house with the most points at the end of the year is presented with the House Cup at the final assembly of the academic year.
Pupils are made very aware of how important it is to be either a humble winner or a gracious loser. Competition is healthy and succeeds in bringing the very best out of children.

Enrichment Opportunities
At Portfields, we believe that learning should be an exciting and enriching experience for all our pupils. We offer a range of opportunities to help our students develop their skills and interests beyond the classroom.
Our school council is a great way for pupils to get involved in decision-making and have their voices heard. We encourage our students to take on leadership roles, such as Year 6 pupil leaders, to develop their confidence and communication skills.
We also offer a variety of trips and visits throughout the year to enhance our pupils’ learning experiences. These trips are designed to be both educational and fun, and are tailored tour curriculum offer. Our pupils have the opportunity to visit museums, galleries, and other places of interest, as well as participate in outdoor activities and team-building exercises.
We believe that enrichment opportunities are an essential part of a well-rounded education, and we are committed to providing our pupils with a range of experiences that will help them grow and develop into confident, well-rounded young people.

School Governors
The school operates a circular model of governance, where leadership and the governing body work collaboratively to plan, review and improve all aspects of the school’s work. This model ensures that decision-making is not linear but cyclical, allowing information, challenge and feedback to move continuously between school leaders and governors.
School leaders, including the Headteacher and Senior Leadership Team (SLT), lead on the day-to-day management of the school and provide regular reports to the governing body on key areas such as educational standards, safeguarding, staffing, finance, and the progress of the school development plan. These reports allow governors to maintain a clear understanding of the school’s performance and priorities.
Governors review the information provided, offering strategic challenge and support to ensure that the school is working effectively and that decisions align with the school’s vision and long-term goals. Through governing body and committee meetings, governors ask questions, seek clarification and provide oversight across all areas of governance.
The outcomes of these discussions inform future planning by school leaders, creating an ongoing cycle of planning, monitoring, challenge and review. This approach ensures that priorities remain aligned with the needs of pupils and the school community, and that actions are continually evaluated and improved.
By working within this circular model, the governing body and school leaders maintain strong strategic oversight, shared accountability and continuous improvement across all aspects of governance.
